{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue == 999999.99)
test_order_mask = data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
num_test_orders = test_order_mask.sum()
print("Number of internal test orders:", num_test_orders)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
completed_mask = data['status'] == 'completed'
completed_and_valid = data[completed_mask & ~test_order_mask]
num_completed_valid = len(completed_and_valid)
print("Number of completed orders after excluding test orders:", num_completed_valid)

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_and_valid['revenue_numeric'].sum()
print("Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders):", total_revenue)"}
